fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' sneezes a fiery glob in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 35% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, slowing down in missile speed after travelling {{tt|1200|estimated}} units. Hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} creates an explosion that deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, with subsequent explosions against the same target dealing 75% damage of the previous explosion's damage.
fields.notes:
* '''Smolder''' can't declare basic attacks for a brief moment after the cast time.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} can block either the glob or the explosion, but not both.
